candidates.title: Choose Path Interactive Split Preview Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the path selection screen with a split view layout featuring direct feature previews for both story mode and desktop companion mode.
candidates.why: Choose_path step has a long mean completion time (514s); clear side-by-side visual comparison speeds up path decision confidence.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Pet Companion Journey
choose_path.body: Select between an interactive story adventure or an active desktop companion on your screen.

guard.reason: Choose path must offer both adopting and making your own pet.

candidates.title: Account Sign In Existing Pet Retrieval Guidance Headline
candidates.change: Update headline and body on sign-in screen to explicitly state that signing in restores existing pets and cloud saves.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Restore Your Pets and Progress
sign_in.body: Log into your account to retrieve your saved pets, custom traits, and sync data across desktop devices.

guard.reason: Valid copy update explaining sign-in pet retrieval.

candidates.score_note: High support email volume (8 emails) supports copy change on sign_in, though sign_in step changes historically carry risk.

candidates.title: Pet Selection Dual Column Focus Layout
candidates.change: Reorganize the friend selection screen into a two-column grid with enlarged pet previews and key personality highlights.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 67.9%.

pick_friend.headline: Pick Your Companion Pet
pick_friend.body: Browse companion personalities and select your favorite companion.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign for pet selection screen.

candidates.score_note: Adoption stage has the largest funnel drop (32.1%), but layout changes in adoption only have single-test positive evidence.

candidates.title: Pet Personality Micro-Milestone Waiting Tracker
candidates.change: Display real-time visual micro-milestone status messages detailing pet personality rendering stages during generation.
candidates.why: Home waiting step averages 201s median time; wait_info changes have proven effective (+4.1%, +3.1%, +2.7%) in earlier iterations.

waiting.headline: Crafting Your Pet's Unique Personality
waiting.body: We are assembling your pet's desktop behaviors, sound effects, and animations.

guard.reason: Valid progress and time estimate display on waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: home, wait_info changes have a solid track record of positive wins (+1.6% noise-corrected average over 9 tests).

candidates.title: Companion Growth Stage Waiting Info Display
candidates.change: Add an animated progress tracker showcasing pet growth stages and desktop activity previews while generation finishes.
candidates.why: Wait info enhancements on the home stage consistently improve conversion across past test wins.

waiting.headline: Your Pet is Getting Ready for Desktop Life
waiting.body: Preparing desktop interactions, idle animations, and desktop movement bounds.

guard.reason: Valid waiting screen growth stage information update.

candidates.score_note: Leverages well-validated home, wait_info change pattern to address long 201s median wait time on home step.

candidates.title: Interactive Companion Context Menu Guided Practice Flow
candidates.change: Introduce an interactive step-by-step practice flow in home_intro teaching users how to right-click their desktop pet to open settings and controls.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or interact with their pet after onboarding; finish new_flow changes have 5 historical wins.

home_intro.headline: Mastering Your Desktop Companion Controls
home_intro.body: Try right-clicking your companion to open the quick desktop interaction menu.

guard.reason: Valid interactive practice flow addition in home intro.

candidates.score_note: finish, new_flow is the strongest historical performer (5 major wins); addresses direct support complaints about pet controls.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Menu Orientation Screen
candidates.change: Add a new dedicated onboarding screen showcasing desktop control hotkeys and right-click menu options before completing setup.
candidates.why: Users experience confusion after onboarding regarding pet controls; finish stage new screen flows leverage strong conversion uplift.

new_controls_orientation.headline: Desktop Companion Controls at a Glance
new_controls_orientation.body: Learn how to access settings, minimize, or interact with your pet on screen.

guard.reason: Valid addition of new orientation screen after home intro.

candidates.score_note: Addresses control confusion at finish step, but adding a static new screen is less proven than interactive new flows.

candidates.title: Companion Sound and Voice Toggle Guided Practice Flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive audio test guided step where users preview and customize their pet's audio cues and sound responses.
candidates.why: Post-onboarding control confusion is a recurring support topic; finish new_flow optimizations consistently produce significant wins.

guard.reason: Valid sound toggle test addition to home intro.

candidates.score_note: Combines highly effective finish, new_flow approach with addressing post-onboarding control confusion.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Generation Error Recovery Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit photo quality requirements hint on upload_photos to prevent custom pet generation failures.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails reporting custom pet generation failures or wrong appearance.

upload_photos.hint: Ensure your photo has clear lighting and a single clear subject to prevent generation issues.

guard.reason: Asks for a user photo, which is personal information.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Final Confirmation Card Layout
candidates.change: Switch adoption_certificate screen layout to card style with structured pet details preview.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 67.9%; structured visual confirmation builds user confidence before waiting stage.

adoption_certificate.headline: Confirm Companion Adoption Details
adoption_certificate.body: Review your pet's adoption certificate before desktop generation begins.

guard.reason: Valid layout update for adoption certificate screen.

candidates.score_note: Targets largest drop-off step (adoption), but structural layout changes in adoption show weak single-test patterns.
